segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ ״קֻוֽנָּם יַיִן שֶׁאֵינִי טוֹעֵם לְשָׁנָה״, נִתְעַבְּרָה הַשָּׁנָה — אָסוּר בָּהּ וּבְעִיבּוּרָהּ. ״עַד רֹאשׁ אֲדָר״ — עַד רֹאשׁ אֲדָר הָרִאשׁוֹן. ״עַד סוֹף אֲדָר״ — עַד סוֹף אֲדָר הָרִאשׁוֹן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of one who said: «Wine is konam» for me, and for «that» reason «I will not taste» it «for the» entire «year,» if «the year was extended,» i.e., it was declared to be a leap year, he is «prohibited» from drinking wine «during» the year «and its intercalated» month. If he vowed «until the beginning of» the month of «Adar,» the vow remains in effect «until the beginning» of «the first Adar.» Similarly, if he says that his vow applies «until the end of Adar,» the vow remains in effect «until the end of the first Adar.»

positions.claim: a year-vow includes the intercalated month; 'Adar' means the first Adar
